Package com.lemarketjames.quotes

Class QuoteHistoryService

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.quotes.QuoteHistoryService
@Service public class QuoteHistoryService extends Object
A stock's price over a ChartRange, for the trade page's chart. Kept apart from QuoteService (current prices) since the two read different sources and change for different reasons.

    • history

      public List<ChartPointDto> history(String rawSymbol, ChartRange range)
      Parameters:
      rawSymbol - ticker symbol; surrounding whitespace and case are ignored
      range - the span to cover
      Returns:
      the stock's prices over range, oldest first, ending with the live price
      Throws:
      QuoteService.QuoteFeedUnavailableException - if the feed is currently down
      QuoteService.SymbolNotFoundException - if no simulated instrument has that ticker

    • intradayForAll

      public Map<String,List<BigDecimal>> intradayForAll()
      Every stock's prices over its current trading day (the same series as a 1D chart), so the trading app can draw all its trend graphs from one request.
      Returns:
      per symbol (sorted), the day's prices oldest first, ending with the live price
      Throws:
      QuoteService.QuoteFeedUnavailableException - if the feed is currently down
